```yaml
name: PR Issue Link Check

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, edited, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  check-issue-link:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install jq
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Validate issue links
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          #!/usr/bin/env bash
          set -euo pipefail

          # Extract PR and repo information from the event payload
          PR_NUMBER=$(jq -r '.pull_request.number' "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH")
          REPO_OWNER=$(jq -r '.repository.owner.login' "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH")
          REPO_NAME=$(jq -r '.repository.name' "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH")

          # Pull request title and body
          PR_TITLE=$(jq -r '.pull_request.title' "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH")
          PR_BODY=$(jq -r '.pull_request.body' "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH")

          # Commit messages
          COMMIT_MESSAGES=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/$REPO_OWNER/$REPO_NAME/pulls/$PR_NUMBER/commits" | \
            jq -r '.[].commit.message')

          # Combine all text for searching
          ALL_TEXT="$PR_TITLE\n$PR_BODY\n$COMMIT_MESSAGES"

          # Find issue references (Fixes #123, Closes #456, Resolves #789)
          ISSUE_NUMBERS=$(echo "$ALL_TEXT" | grep -Eo "(Fixes|Closes|Resolves)\s*#([0-9]+)" | \
            sed -E 's/.*#([0-9]+).*/\1/' | sort -u)

          if [ -z "$ISSUE_NUMBERS" ]; then
            echo "❌ No issue references found in PR title, body, or commits."
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "Found issue references: $ISSUE_NUMBERS"

          # Validate each referenced issue exists
          for ISSUE in $ISSUE_NUMBERS; do
            echo "Checking issue #$ISSUE..."
            RESPONSE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" \
              -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" \
              "https://api.github.com/repos/$REPO_OWNER/$REPO_NAME/issues/$ISSUE")
            if [ "$RESPONSE" -ne 200 ]; then
              echo "❌ Issue #$ISSUE does not exist or is inaccessible."
              exit 1
            else
              echo "✅ Issue #$ISSUE exists."
            fi
          done

          echo "All referenced issues exist. PR is valid."
```
